not_walked.label: Provisional - not site walked
not_walked.intro: This project was not site walked. Every item gathered so far is now tagged confirmed or assumed, one at a time. Anything left assumed appears verbatim in the assumptions block of the document.
not_walked.item_prompt: Is this confirmed, or is it an assumption?
not_walked.basis_help: Who told you, or what document shows it. 'Customer facilities manager confirmed by email 12 Aug' - not 'confirmed'.

walked.label: Observed - site walked
walked.intro: This project was site walked. Each item is recorded as observed on the walk, or flagged as not actually verified during it. Do not mark something observed because it seems obvious - only if it was seen.
walked.item_prompt: Was this observed during the walk?

options.label: Not observed - carry as open item

walked.basis_help: The observation itself, in the words you would use to defend the price. 'Existing 2in EMT runs the length of the north wall with pull string in place.'

not_walked.prompt: What ceiling construction is assumed throughout?
What is assumed about existing pathways - conduit, tray, J-hooks, riser capacity?
What is assumed about IDF/MDF locations, rack space and power at each?
What existing infrastructure is assumed serviceable and reused?
Are there any known hazardous material, asbestos or abatement considerations?
Where did the device counts come from?
not_walked.help: If the counts came off a drawing or a conversation rather than a walk, the document has to say that.

walked.prompt: What ceiling construction was observed, and where does it change?
What existing pathways were observed - conduit, tray, J-hooks, riser capacity, fill?
What was observed at each IDF/MDF - rack space, power, switch capacity, condition?
What obstructions or access problems were observed?
walked.help: Racking, hard lids, low clearance, live production areas, tenant restrictions.

walked.prompt: What existing security equipment was observed, and what is its condition?
Anything else observed that affects price or schedule?
